dropped_features.*_pctile_252d: spx_core_2007 panel starts 2007-01-03; only ~251 trading days at train_end=2007-12-31, leaving zero valid rows after 252-day rolling-rank warmup.
dropped_features.term_structure_*: Group 3 features (vix3m_minus_vix, etc.) require VIX3M/VIX9D/VIX6M which are unavailable.
dropped_features.vix3m_*: VIX3M (originally VXV) launched 2007-12-04; only ~20 days of usable history at train_end.
dropped_features.vix6m_*: VIX6M launched 2008-01-02; not available at train_end=2007-12-31.
dropped_features.vix9d_*: VIX9D launched 2011-02-23; not available at train_end=2007-12-31.
dropped_features.vvix_*: VVIX truncated to 2012-04-01 in the processed layer; entirely NaN through Crisis-2008 window.

headline.rationale: spx_full is the full SPX vol family from Track A; all 35 features have ample history at train_end=2019-12-31.

recovery_for_f4.rationale: F4 recovery: spx_full's LR and LightGbmTuned cells are NaN under Crisis-2020 because vvix_pctile_252d propagates documented VVIX gaps (2019-07-05, 2020-06-11) through the entire test window. Removing the 4 VVIX-derived features eliminates the cascade. The four panel-DataFrame baselines (NaiveBaseRate, VIXPercentileRaw, VIXPercentileCalibrated, HarRvThreshold) keep their valid spx_full results — they do not read the feature matrix and were unaffected by F4.

robustness_check.rationale: Symmetric feature set with Crisis-2008 (11 features) for cross-crisis comparability under D3 override.
